name: PLEX - Pick Next Claim
description: Implements assignmentRulesv1.0.json selection. Called by the Power App and by the PLEX agent. Bucket order first, then DaysAssignedToRO desc, DateOfClaim asc, ClaimId asc.

trigger.type: PowerAppV2 / Request (When an agent calls the flow)

actions.note: Reads MaxPerRequestDefault and MaxPerRequestBucket1..6. A blank bucket cap uses the default.

filter: (PL_Bucket ne 4 or PL_GAPerOfRecord eq '@{triggerBody()?['userEmail']}' or PL_AuthOfRecord eq '@{triggerBody()?['userEmail']}' or (PL_GAPerOfRecord eq null and PL_AuthOfRecord eq null))
actions.orderBy: PL_Bucket asc, DaysAssignedToRO desc, DateOfClaim asc, ClaimId asc
actions.note: PL_Bucket is stored by EnrichClaim, so one indexed ORDER BY gives bucket first, then days desc. Filters keep bucket 4 to the GAPer/AUTHer of record and bucket 5 AUTH to AttyFeeAuthorizer users.

actions.expression: claims already taken from this bucket in the request < cap(bucket)
actions.ifFalse: Re-query with PL_Bucket gt <capped bucket> so the next bucket is evaluated instead of one bucket always being selected.

actions.concurrency: Re-read the item ETag and retry once so two users cannot get the same claim
